details.description: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 is a 12-billion-parameter unified reasoning and non-reasoning language model built by NVIDIA on a hybrid Mamba-2/Transformer architecture, combining mostly Mamba-2 and MLP layers with six attention layers. Released August 29, 2025, it can generate an internal reasoning trace before its final answer, toggled with a "/think" or "/no_think" system prompt and a configurable thinking-token budget. It was trained on 20 trillion tokens of public web, code, and academic text plus synthetic reasoning data distilled from DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen models, and is released under the NVIDIA Open Model License for commercial use.
advantages: Scores 97.75% on MATH500 with reasoning enabled, per its model card.
Scores 76.25% on AIME25 with reasoning enabled, per its model card.
Scores 89.81% on IFEval instruction-following with reasoning enabled, per its model card.
Reasoning can be toggled on or off, and its thinking-token budget capped, to trade accuracy for latency.
disadvantages: Its model card reports a slight accuracy decrease on harder tasks when reasoning is turned off.
Reasoning mode uses more tokens and adds latency versus non-reasoning mode, per its model card.
use_cases: Multi-step reasoning and math problem solving

notes: Attempts to reach build.nvidia.com and an NVIDIA developer-blog page for this model both 404'd, so only the Hugging Face model card (published by NVIDIA's own org account) was used. Could not confirm whether a newer Nemotron Nano version has superseded this one as of the research date.
